LIVE reader: YUK-795 loadPredictionAccountabilityByKey calls the Tier-1 dissociation decision and consumes INSUFFICIENT/EMERGING in nightly conjecture ranking. The background caller always passes ownerFreshlyConfirmed=false, so it is structurally unable to mutate source soft->hard. The flag remains default OFF because the current Judge has no honest target_error_match fact and a protected hard flip still requires a dedicated fresh owner confirmation command. See ADR-0050 §(b2).

HUB_SYNC_MODE.notes: Default off. Exact env literals (no trim); invalid falls back to off. Off retains trigger bookkeeping. No production flip.

MEMORY_RECONCILE_HANDOFF_MODE.notes: Default observe; consumer trims then validates, invalid non-empty values throw. write/recover persist new intents; recover/drain run recovery.

INTERVENTION_DISABLED_METHOD_IDS.notes: Default empty list. Env is comma-separated, trimmed, empty members removed; DB is a method-id array. Consumer rejects unknown pedagogy method IDs.

EXTRACT_OCR_ENGINE.notes: Default glm; exact env literals (no trim), invalid falls back to glm. Explicit dependency injection can override the engine for a call.

DOCX_CONVERT_ENGINE.notes: Only docker is an explicit configured value. Unset/other env values select the automatic path; viareader is not a configurable enum value.

AI_PROVIDER_ATTEMPT_ADMISSION_MODE.notes: Default off; trimmed mode, invalid throws. Off bypasses policy parsing; missing per-lane policy also resolves off.

AI_PROVIDER_ATTEMPT_ADMISSION_POLICIES_J.notes: Env JSON / DB object keyed by known attempt lane; strict positive maxConcurrentAttempts and maxAttemptStartsPerMinute. Invalid JSON/shape/unknown lane throws when active; absent policy bypasses lane.

AI_PROVIDER_SESSION_ADMISSION_MODE.notes: Default off; trimmed mode, invalid throws. Off skips policies; an unlisted provider lane resolves off.

AI_PROVIDER_SESSION_ADMISSION_POLICIES_J.notes: Required non-empty provider-keyed object in observe/enforce; env JSON or DB object. Consumer validates known providers, strict fields and integer bounds for concurrency/start rate/queue/wait. Off ignores policies; missing lane bypasses.

PROJECTION_IS_WRITER_ITEM_CALIBRATION.notes: Default OFF write-ownership switch. Shared config reader preserves registry's exact env literal '1'; other env strings fall back to false. DB boolean override remains supported. No production flip.
